verdict.rationale: Asana documents a broad, resource-oriented REST API with a published OpenAPI spec, official JavaScript and Python SDKs, webhooks, and an official MCP server for task/project management. Coverage visibly reaches tasks, status updates, and even AI Teammate (agent) records, but no evidence states that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature. missing for 10: explicit documented UI/API parity claim, evidence of API coverage for areas like rules, AI Studio and Dash, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
